_document.title: CareerMate employer portal registry
_document.description: Copy this file to data/sources.json to use it as the active employer ATS configuration. Replace every example identifier and URL with the company's real public career-page and ATS-board details. All example portals are disabled.

url_fields.career_url: The employer's main career page, for example https://careers.example.com/jobs
url_fields.jobs_url: The public ATS job-board URL. CareerMate uses the ATS identifier for API discovery; this URL is a human-readable shortcut.

_document.security: Never place API keys, passwords, cookies, or session tokens in this file. Store Teamtailor API keys in backend/.env and reference only the environment variable name.

greenhouse.notes: Replace board_token with the Greenhouse board token shown in the public job-board URL.

lever.notes: The site value is the Lever site slug, not the full URL.

teamtailor.notes: Create a Teamtailor API key with the required public-read permission. Put its value in backend/.env under the variable named by api_key_env.

ashby.notes: The slug is the final path segment in the public Ashby job-board URL.

smartrecruiters.notes: Use the SmartRecruiters company identifier as slug.

workday.notes: Workday requires the full public HTTPS careers URL including its site path.
